title.th: พระราชบัญญัติจัดตั้งโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาตอนปลายแห่งชาติในบารังไกย์ Liburon, เมือง Carcar, จังหวัด Cebu ให้เป็นที่รู้จักในชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาตอนปลายแห่งชาติ Liburon

text.en: Establishment of a National High School. – There is hereby established, under the supervision of the Department of Education, a national high school in Barangay Liburon, City of Carcar, Province of Cebu to be known as Liburon National High School.

Appropriations. – The Secretary of Education shall immediately include in the Department’s program the operationalization of the Liburon National High School, the funding of which shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
Implementation. – The Secretary of Education shall issue rules and regulations that may be necessary to carry out the purpose of this Act.
Effectivity. – This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette.
